## Skills available in this repo

- `skills/decision-spine/` — apply the Decision Spine to a system. Invoked when
  designing, reviewing at a gate, or writing an architecture document.
- `skills/field-note/` — capture what a domain practitioner knows and promote it
  into an ADR, a test, or a project constraint. Invoked when someone says they
  have seen something go wrong in the field, when writing or dispositioning a
  field note, and when someone says they do not write software.
- `skills/survey/` — run the intake that precedes a build: constraints, load,
  invariants, and a readiness verdict on every decision before any ADR is written.
  Invoked when scoping a new system or feature, when asked what still needs to be
  decided, when generating a handoff package, and when a build's ADRs keep churning.
